Today, I took my dogs around my neighborhood. After they went #2 twice, I had 2 nicely filled bags. While rounding a corner, my dog peed on a grassy easement for one second, and kept moving. At the next house, I heard someone yell for me. Turning around, I saw my neighbor. He said he'd appreciate it if I picked up after my dogs. I said "I do", and I held up the 2 aforementioned bags. He then pointed at the easement. I said "she peed". Instead of hearing "oh", he said "well, I'd appreciate it if they didn't pee in my yard". I told him that it was the easement, and that I keep my dogs out of people's yards. He then said "well, they can do their business on city property". I pointed out that the easement IS city property. Then, he got mad and said "well, I planted all of the grass". Frustrated, I just said "whatever", and left feeling pretty angry. I tried to do the right thing by walking my dogs, keeping them off of people's grass, and picking up after them. I try very hard to be neighborly, and I tried to point out that I try to be one of the good guys that doesn't leave dog waste everywhere. But, this neighbor had a very different opinion. I want to know what people think. Am I in the wrong? What should I do if I pass by that way again?
